concept.title: What is Coverity?
concept.shortdesc: Brief description of what Coverity is, how it works and what its used for

conbody.p: Coverity is a SAST tool used to read ones source code and detect vulnerabilities, bugs, and poor code quality and standerds

dlentry.dd: Coverity analysis is component that is scanning through your source code for issues to flag.

Coverity component is the web interface where the issues found by Coverity analysis are logged. These issues are given a description with information such as what the issue is, who may have inputed it, severity level and more. These issues can be triaged, assigned to devs and tracked over time.

section.title: How Coverity works
section.p: Checkers are a collection of programs. Each collection focuses on a specific issue and there are hundreds of checkers. So a wide range of issues are taken a look at from simple to complex. Some examples of what checkers check for are the following.
Checkers can be configured to be more suited for your development needs.

section.title: Pros and Cons of Coverity
section.p: Coverity is a great tool that has many advanatages however at the expense of some shortcomings.

row.entry: Can be used early in SDLC
Does not need code to run to analyze
Can not test run time specific issues
Comes with web interface that can provide reports, triaging and other services to keep track of issues
